promotionalText: Autheris now runs on the Mac as well as iPhone and iPad. No account, no tracking — your codes stay on your device.
description:
Secure your accounts with Autheris — a privacy-first two-factor authentication app for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Autheris generates the time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) that protect your most important accounts, and keeps the secrets behind them on your device. No account, no sign-up, no ads.

KEY FEATURES
• One-Tap Codes — Copy a code with a single tap. The clipboard clears itself after 60 seconds.
• Pin and Reorder — Pin the codes you use most to the top, and drag the rest into whatever order suits you.
• Recently Deleted — Delete a code by mistake? It stays on your device for 7 days, ready to restore.
• QR Scanning — Add an account by scanning a QR code, or choose a screenshot from your photo library.
• SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 — Including the services that need more than the default. If a service rejects your codes, the algorithm is editable per account.
• Import — Bring your accounts across from Google Authenticator, Aegis, andOTP or 2FAS.
• Search — Find any account instantly, however long your list gets.
• Issuer Icons — Familiar brand marks so you can spot an account at a glance.
• Countdown Ring — A clear, color-customizable ring shows how long each code has left.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
• Face ID / Touch ID Lock — Locks when opened, and again after 30 seconds away.
• Blurred When Backgrounded — Content blurs when you switch apps, and your codes are hidden in the app switcher.
• Protected While Recording — Codes are covered whenever your screen is being recorded or mirrored.
• Secrets Stay on Your Device — Codes and setup keys are kept in your device's Keychain and never leave your device unless you export them or turn on iCloud Sync.
• Encrypted Backups — Save an AES-256-GCM encrypted backup protected by a password only you know.
• Optional iCloud Sync — Off by default. When you enable it, your secrets are end-to-end encrypted by CloudKit, and the developer cannot read them.
• No Account, No Tracking — Nothing to sign up for, no analytics, no advertising. Autheris is open source.

Install Autheris, add an account, and keep your second factor under your own control.
whatsNew:
Autheris 2.2 brings the app to the Mac.

• Now on the Mac — a native Mac app with the same codes, sync and settings as your iPhone and iPad.

• A proper Mac Settings window, opened with ⌘, and organised into General, Privacy, iCloud, Data and Help.

• Scan QR codes with your Mac's camera, and unlock with Touch ID or your login password.

• Codes are hidden from screen sharing and recording, and copied codes are marked as concealed so they do not travel to your other devices.

• Plus fixes for a set of Mac teething problems: sheets that opened empty or could not be closed, buttons that did not respond, and a crash when starting the scanner.
